welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.lede: Let's set up your assistant right here in the app. It takes about two minutes.
welcome.fact_commands: It runs commands, opens apps and changes files for you.
welcome.fact_screen: It can see your screen and act on it when you ask.
welcome.fact_cloud: What you say goes to the AI provider you choose.
welcome.fact_costs: Usage is billed by that provider, on your account.
welcome.fact_mistakes: It can make mistakes, including ones that are hard to undo.
welcome.accept: I understand this and use it at my own risk.
welcome.read_terms: Read the full Terms of Use
welcome.accept_failed: Your agreement could not be saved. Check that the app is running, then try again.
welcome.declined_body: You declined, so nothing was set up and nothing was saved. Start the app again anytime and it will ask again.

keys.title: Add one API key
keys.lede: This is the API Keys page. Paste one key into a provider card and save it. OpenAI or Gemini gives you live voice with a single key.
keys.present: A key is saved. You can continue.
keys.partial: Some parts did not switch ({parts}). You can fix them later on this page.
keys.security: Keys go into your system's keychain and only ever to the provider you picked.

permissions.title: Allow access on this Mac
permissions.lede: These are the Mac permissions. Allow the ones you want; each row updates by itself.
permissions.note: You can come back to them anytime in Settings. The restart at the end applies them.

voice.title: Choose your wake word
voice.lede: Type your word after "Hey" here and save it. The word also becomes the assistant's name. No wake word? The Call shortcut works anytime.
voice.off: No wake word yet. The Call shortcut works meanwhile.

ready.title: All set
ready.lede: The app restarts once to switch everything on. Then a short tour shows you around.
ready.no_key_note: Without a key, chat and voice stay off until you add one on the API Keys page.
ready.preview_note: This is a replay, so nothing restarts. Start opens the tour.
ready.restart_note: The restart takes about ten seconds.
ready.start_failed: Setup could not be finished. Check that the app is running, then try again.

app_tour.label: App tour
app_tour.replay_body: A short walk through the app with the spotlight, the same one you saw after setup.

steps.voice: This is how you talk to {name}. Click the bar, say your wake word or press your Call keys, then just speak. The wave shows who is talking.
steps.new_chat: Rather type? Start a new chat here, as text or voice. Every conversation lands under Recent chats.
steps.agents: Agents are your team: helpers that take on bigger jobs in the background. Let's look inside.
steps.agents_world: This is the Verse, your agents at work. Click one to chat with it or hand it a job. Next brings you back.
steps.voice_hub: Voice holds dictation into any app, your own word list and spoken shortcuts.
steps.artifacts: Everything {name} makes, from pages to images to reports, is kept in Artifacts.
steps.ide: The Agentic IDE runs coding agents side by side in real terminals, on your own projects.
steps.plugins: Plugins, skills and MCP connect {name} to your apps. The store icon at the bottom opens the Marketplace.
steps.settings: Settings, API keys, costs and your profile live here. You can replay this tour anytime from Settings → App.
steps.done: That's the tour. You're ready: talk to {name} whenever you like.
